captions.detailed: A portable, cup-holder-mounted in-car air purifier featuring a dark cylindrical base and a wider top disc housing. The top disk housing has a gray circular upper face accented by a small blue central button, with a black rectangular filter cap snapped onto its side. The filter cap is designed to snap off radially via a short prismatic joint, while the internal filter cartridge can slide out prismatically through the side opening.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a portable in-car air purifier designed to mount in a cup holder. The model should feature a cylindrical lower base, a wider disc-shaped top housing with a circular gray top face and a blue button, and a black rectangular side filter cap. Incorporate a prismatic joint that allows the filter cap to snap off radially, and another prismatic joint for the internal filter cartridge to slide out of the side.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a cylinder for the cup-holder base, topped with a larger cylinder for the main housing disc, and a flat cylinder for the top cap. Create the side filter cap using a box primitive with a small gray release button on its outer face. Model the internal filter cartridge as a cylinder oriented horizontally. Define a prismatic joint for the filter cap moving radially outward along the X-axis, and a second prismatic joint for the internal filter cartridge sliding out along the same axis.
